2. HOW TO PLAY This machine is a variety game played with only one lever per player. How to Control The lever is moved left or right to control the movement of the character on the screen. Modes This machine has three modes. One Player Mode This is the “Trial” mode played by a single player. 5 mini games, (selected at random by the game PCB), are played with one credit. The player is allowed to play 5 mini games regardless of whether they complete each mini game. After 4 mini games have been played the player is assigned to one of 15 levels, (depending upon the scores for the 4 mini games played), for the 5th mini game. (Number of games to be played is selectable in Game Options). Match Mode for 2 Players This is the “Match Mode” played by 2 players. The players contest the game by hitting each others lever to interrupt the other player. The player who achieves the best result wins the game. 5 mini games, (selected at random by the game PCB), are played with one credit for each player. The player is allowed to play 5 mini games regardless of whether they complete each mini game. Only this mode has bonus extended play option. Three further stages, (selected at random by the game PCB), can be played for one extra credit after the 5th mini game. (Number of games to be played is selectable in Game Options). Panic King Mode This is the “Score Attack Mode” for advanced players. The players can select Panic King Mode by pressing and holding the left or right start button when inserting the coin(s). Only one game can be played per credit. The choice of game to be played is automatically changed by the game PCB each month. Rules of the Game. As this is a variety game, the rules are different for each mini game. In some of the mini games, NORM (only in one player mode) and LIFE are displayed. NORM represents the number of items that the player is to try and achieve. LIFE represents the number of times the player is allowed to fail by hitting an obstacle, etc. In One Player Mode and Match Mode if LIFE becomes 0 the mini game being played is over. Page 30
